text:
Hermes Agent is **not** limited to the command line—an official web interface is available where you can chat directly in the browser.

To launch the web interface, run:

```bash
hermes dashboard
```

This will host the Web UI Dashboard locally at **`http://127.0.0.1:9119`**, featuring an embedded browser chat interface and settings management.

*(Note: You can also interact with Hermes Agent via messaging gateways such as Telegram, Discord, Matrix, DingTalk, and Weixin using `hermes gateway setup`.)*
